vulnerability.title: Oracle Front-Running on Synth Exchanges During Volatility Spikes
vulnerability.category: Synthetic Debt Pool & Oracle Latency Front-Running
vulnerability.rootCause: Delay between off-chain FX/crypto market price movements and on-chain oracle transaction mined blocks.
vulnerability.attackVector: Bot observes off-chain BTC spike on Binance, submits high-gas transaction swapping sUSD to sBTC before Chainlink feed updates.

remediationOpenZeppelin:
--- a/contracts/Exchanger.sol
+++ b/contracts/Exchanger.sol
@@ -210,3 +210,4 @@
+ require(block.timestamp >= lastOracleUpdate + WAITING_PERIOD, 'Trading in settling window');
